observed_value: interest_rate='', basis_spread='' on X02 flagged private-credit rows
anchor_value: source table row contains Reference Rate and Spread SOFR + 6.00% with the Interest Rate cell blank

culprit_citations.quoted_text: M&D MidCo, Inc. | Term Loan | SOFR | + | 6.00 % | (Q) | [blank Interest Rate] | 8/31/2022 | 8/31/2028 | 63 | 63 | 63 | (6)(9)

findings.detail: A private-credit term-loan row has source reference-spread terms (SOFR + 6.00%) but the flagged extract has neither interest_rate nor basis_spread, so the available basis leg was not captured.

rationale: X02 flags private-credit rows where both interest_rate and basis_spread are missing. In the raw SOI schedule, table 42 row 29 is a Term Loan for M&D MidCo, Inc. with Reference Rate and Spread shown as SOFR + 6.00% (Q), while the Interest Rate cell is blank. The source therefore contains rate-term information that should satisfy the basis-spread side of the rule; the flagged blank extract is a real extraction gap rather than a false alarm. Some other source rows show N/A terms, so the aggregate 63-row flag may include mixed subcases, but this cited row grounds at least one real data defect.
